org.apache.opendal.layer
Wrappers to configure the underneath layers.
  • Classes in org.apache.opendal.layer used by org.apache.opendal.layer
    Class
    Description
    CacheLayer
    Caches aligned chunks of reads in a separate operator.
    CacheLayer.CacheLayerBuilder
    Configures the cache chunk size and metadata freshness.
    ConcurrentLimitLayer
    Limits concurrent storage operations.
    ConcurrentLimitLayer.ConcurrentLimitLayerBuilder
    Configures optional limits for reads, writes, lists, and HTTP requests.
    HedgeLayer.HedgeLayerBuilder
    Builds a hedge layer with optional per-operation delays.
    RouteLayer
    Routes storage operations by matching paths against glob patterns in the order the routes were added.
    RouteLayer.RouteLayerBuilder
    Collects ordered routes and builds one layer.
    TailCutLayer
    Cancels slow calls using an adaptive deadline based on recent successful calls.
    TailCutLayer.TailCutLayerBuilder
    Configures the latency history and adaptive deadline.
    TimeoutLayer
    Applies deadlines to control operations and individual I/O calls.
    TimeoutLayer.Operation
    Identifies an operation that can have its own timeout.
    TimeoutLayer.TimeoutLayerBuilder
    Configures the default and per-operation timeouts for a timeout layer.
